name: NIST 800-53
description: Standard tier — defence-in-depth access control, integrity, and audit

controls.name: Containers run as non-root
controls.description: AC-6: Principle of least privilege — containers must not run as root

checks.name: Container runs as non-root
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, (has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot)) ? c.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true : (has(object.spec.securityContext) && has(object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot) && object.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true))

controls.name: No privilege escalation
controls.description: AC-6(1): Containers must not allow privilege escalation

checks.name: Privilege escalation disabled
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation) && c.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false)

controls.name: No privileged containers
controls.description: AC-6(2): Containers must not run in privileged mode

checks.name: Privileged mode disabled
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, !(has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.privileged) && c.securityContext.privileged == true))

controls.name: Service account token not auto-mounted
controls.description: AC-3: Disable automatic service account token mounting

controls.name: Pod-level security context
controls.description: AC-6: Pod must define security context with runAsNonRoot

controls.name: Host network disabled
controls.description: AC-4: Containers must not use host networking

controls.name: Host PID namespace disabled
controls.description: AC-4: Containers must not share host PID namespace

controls.name: Application label present
controls.description: CM-8: All workloads must be labelled for inventory

controls.name: Version label present
controls.description: CM-8(1): Workloads must declare their version

controls.name: Resource limits defined
controls.description: CM-6: Containers must have resource limits configured

checks.name: CPU and memory limits defined
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.resources) && has(c.resources.limits))

controls.name: Resource requests defined
controls.description: CM-6: Containers must declare resource requests

checks.name: CPU and memory requests defined
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.resources) && has(c.resources.requests))

controls.name: Managed-by label present
controls.description: CM-3: Workloads must declare their management toolchain

controls.name: Environment label present
controls.description: CM-3(1): Workloads must declare their target environment

controls.name: Drop all capabilities
controls.description: SC-7: Containers must drop all Linux capabilities

checks.name: All capabilities dropped
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities) && has(c.securityContext.capabilities.drop) && c.securityContext.capabilities.drop.exists(d, d == 'ALL'))

controls.name: Read-only root filesystem
controls.description: SC-28: Containers must use read-only root filesystem

checks.name: Read-only root filesystem
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.securityContext) && has(c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem) && c.securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem == true)

controls.name: TLS configuration annotation
controls.description: SC-8: Workloads must declare their TLS configuration

controls.name: Seccomp profile applied
controls.description: SC-39: Containers must use a seccomp profile

controls.name: Encryption at rest annotation
controls.description: SC-28(1): Workloads must declare encryption-at-rest status

controls.name: Image pinned by digest
controls.description: SI-7: Container images must use digest references

checks.name: Image uses sha256 digest
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && (object.spec.containers + (has(object.spec.initContainers) ? object.spec.initContainers : [])).all(c, has(c.image) && c.image.contains('@sha256:'))

controls.name: Trusted registry enforcement
controls.description: SI-7(1): Images must originate from approved registries

controls.name: Vulnerability scan annotation
controls.description: SI-2: Container images must reference vulnerability scan results

controls.name: Liveness probe configured
controls.description: SI-4: Workloads must have liveness probes for health monitoring

controls.name: Readiness probe configured
controls.description: SI-4: Workloads must have readiness probes for availability

controls.name: Audit logging label
controls.description: AU-2: Workloads must declare audit logging configuration

controls.name: Log volume mount present
controls.description: AU-3: Workloads must mount a log volume for audit collection

checks.name: Log volume mount exists
checks.celExpression: has(object.spec) && has(object.spec.containers) && size(object.spec.containers) > 0 && object.spec.containers.all(c, has(c.volumeMounts) && c.volumeMounts.exists(v, has(v.mountPath) && v.mountPath.startsWith('/var/log')))

controls.name: Log format annotation
controls.description: AU-3(1): Workloads must declare their log format

controls.name: Owner label present
controls.description: AU-6: Workloads must declare an owner for audit trail
